literal: Lu Fahe; Wang Lin
idiomatic: Lu Fahe; Wang Lin

literal: Lu Fahe—no one knew where he was from.
idiomatic: Lu Fahe—no one knew where he was from.

literal: He lived in seclusion on Bailizhou at Jiangling; food, clothing, and dwelling were all the same as an ascetic śramaṇa's.
idiomatic: He lived in seclusion on Bailizhou at Jiangling; food, clothing, and dwelling were all the same as an ascetic śramaṇa's.

literal: Elders had seen him from childhood; his countenance was ever unsteady, and none could fathom him.
idiomatic: Elders had seen him from childhood; his countenance was ever unsteady, and none could fathom him.

literal: Some said he had come forth from Songgao and wandered far and near.
idiomatic: Some said he had come forth from Songgao and wandered far and near.

literal: When he entered Zishishan in Gao'an county, Wenyang commandery, Jing province, he for no apparent reason abandoned the mountain where he dwelt.
idiomatic: When he entered Zishishan in Gao'an county, Wenyang commandery, Jing province, he for no apparent reason abandoned the mountain where he dwelt.

literal: Before long the rebel bandit Wen Daoqi arose; the people of the time took it that he had foreseen the omen.
idiomatic: Before long the rebel bandit Wen Daoqi arose; the people of the time took it that he had foreseen the omen.

literal: When Hou Jing first announced surrender to Liang, Fahe said to Zhu Yuanying of Nan commandery: "This humble monk together with my patron shall drive Hou Jing away.
idiomatic: When Hou Jing first announced surrender to Liang, Fahe said to Zhu Yuanying of Nan commandery, "This humble monk together with my patron shall drive Hou Jing away.

literal: " Yuanying said: "Hou Jing is rendering service to the state; Master, you say strike him—why?
idiomatic: " Yuanying said, "Hou Jing is rendering service to the state; Master, you say strike him—why?

literal: " Fahe said: "It is precisely for that reason.
idiomatic: " Fahe said, "It is precisely for that reason.

literal: " When Jing crossed the Yangtze, Fahe was then on Mount Qingxi; Yuanying went to ask: "Jing now besieges the capital—how stands the matter?
idiomatic: " When Jing crossed the Yangtze, Fahe was then on Mount Qingxi; Yuanying went to ask, "Jing now besieges the capital—how stands the matter?

literal: " Fahe said: "When mere men take fruit, they should wait until it is ripe; pluck too soon and it falls of itself.
idiomatic: " Fahe said, "When mere men take fruit, they should wait until it is ripe; pluck too soon and it falls of itself.

literal: My patron need only wait until Hou Jing ripens—why trouble to ask?
idiomatic: My patron need only wait until Hou Jing ripens—why trouble to ask?

literal: " Pressed repeatedly, he at last said: "He may be taken, and he may not."
idiomatic: " Pressed repeatedly, he at last said, "He may be taken, and he may not."

literal: Jing sent his general Ren Yue to strike the Prince of Xiangdong at Jiangling; Fahe then went to the Prince of Xiangdong begging to campaign against Yue, mustered eight hundred barbarian disciples at the river crossing, and set out within two days.
idiomatic: Jing sent his general Ren Yue to strike the Prince of Xiangdong at Jiangling; Fahe then went to the Prince of Xiangdong begging to campaign against Yue, mustered eight hundred barbarian disciples at the river crossing, and set out within two days.

literal: The Prince of Xiangdong sent Hu Sengyou leading more than a thousand men to march with him.
idiomatic: The Prince of Xiangdong sent Hu Sengyou leading more than a thousand men to march with him.

literal: Fahe boarded the ship and laughed aloud: "Measureless troops and horses.
idiomatic: Fahe boarded the ship and laughed aloud, "Measureless troops and horses.

literal: " Jiangling had many spirit shrines; the custom was constant prayer, but from the day Fahe's army marched out not one prayer was answered—the people thought the spirits had all gone with the army.
idiomatic: " Jiangling had many spirit shrines; the custom was constant prayer, but from the day Fahe's army marched out not one prayer was answered—the people thought the spirits had all gone with the army.

literal: At Chisha Lake they faced Yue; Fahe took a light boat, wore no armor, drifted downstream, and turned back a li from Yue's army.
idiomatic: At Chisha Lake they faced Yue; Fahe took a light boat, wore no armor, drifted downstream, and turned back a li from Yue's army.

literal: He told the officers and men: "I have only come to see whether their dragon lies asleep; our army's dragon is leaping on its own—attack at once.
idiomatic: He told the officers and men, "I have only come to see whether their dragon lies asleep; our army's dragon is leaping on its own—attack at once.

literal: If we could wait until tomorrow, we might break the bandits without losing a man on either side, but there would be an ill turn.
idiomatic: If we could wait until tomorrow, we might break the bandits without losing a man on either side, but there would be an ill turn.

literal: " They then sent fire-ships ahead, but the headwind was unfavorable; Fahe waved a white feather to command the wind, and the wind at once reversed.
idiomatic: " They then sent fire-ships ahead, but the headwind was unfavorable; Fahe waved a white feather to command the wind, and the wind at once reversed.

literal: Yue's host all saw Liang infantry walking on the water; at that they broke utterly and threw themselves into the river to die.
idiomatic: Yue's host all saw Liang infantry walking on the water; at that they broke utterly and threw themselves into the river to die.

literal: Yue fled and was lost to sight.
idiomatic: Yue fled and was lost to sight.

literal: Fahe said: "At noon tomorrow he will be taken.
idiomatic: Fahe said, "At noon tomorrow he will be taken.

literal: " When the hour came and he was not taken, men asked him; Fahe said: "I earlier built a shrine on this islet when the water was dry and told you patrons that though it is a shrine, in truth it is a bandit-marker—why not seek the bandit beneath the marker now?
idiomatic: " When the hour came and he was not taken, men asked him; Fahe said, "I earlier built a shrine on this islet when the water was dry and told you patrons that though it is a shrine, in truth it is a bandit-marker—why not seek the bandit beneath the marker now?

literal: " As he said, they indeed saw Yue in the water clinging to the shrine with head thrown back, only his nose above the surface; they seized him.
idiomatic: " As he said, they indeed saw Yue in the water clinging to the shrine with head thrown back, only his nose above the surface; they seized him.

literal: Yue begged to die before the Master's eyes; Fahe said: "My patron has the look of fortune—he will surely not die by the sword; moreover he has karmic tie with the prince—set your mind at rest. The prince hereafter will gain my patron's strength.
idiomatic: Yue begged to die before the Master's eyes; Fahe said, "My patron has the look of fortune—he will surely not die by the sword; moreover he has karmic tie with the prince—set your mind at rest. The prince hereafter will gain my patron's strength.

literal: " The Prince of Xiangdong indeed released him and employed him as commandery administrator.
idiomatic: " The Prince of Xiangdong indeed released him and employed him as commandery administrator.

literal: When Wei besieged Jiangling, Yue came with troops to the rescue and fought fiercely.
idiomatic: When Wei besieged Jiangling, Yue came with troops to the rescue and fought fiercely.

literal: After Fahe had pacified Yue, he went forward to see Wang Sengbian at Baling and said: "This humble monk has already cut off one arm of Hou Jing—what more can he do? My patron should press the attack at once.
idiomatic: After Fahe had pacified Yue, he went forward to see Wang Sengbian at Baling and said, "This humble monk has already cut off one arm of Hou Jing—what more can he do? My patron should press the attack at once.

literal: " He then asked leave to return and told the Prince of Xiangdong: "Hou Jing will naturally be pacified—nothing to worry over.
idiomatic: " He then asked leave to return and told the Prince of Xiangdong, "Hou Jing will naturally be pacified—nothing to worry over.

literal: Shu bandits are about to arrive; Fahe asks to hold Wuxia Gorge and await them.
idiomatic: Shu bandits are about to arrive; Fahe asks to hold Wuxia Gorge and await them.

literal: " He then gathered all armies and went, himself hauling stone to fill the river.
idiomatic: " He then gathered all armies and went, himself hauling stone to fill the river.

literal: In three days the water split into channels; he spanned them with iron chains.
idiomatic: In three days the water split into channels; he spanned them with iron chains.

literal: The Prince of Wuling Ji indeed sent Shu troops to cross; the gorge mouth was cramped and they could neither advance nor retreat.
idiomatic: The Prince of Wuling Ji indeed sent Shu troops to cross; the gorge mouth was cramped and they could neither advance nor retreat.

literal: Wang Lin and Fahe laid plans together; one battle and they were annihilated.
idiomatic: Wang Lin and Fahe laid plans together; one battle and they were annihilated.

literal: The army halted at Baidi; he told men: "Zhuge Kongming may be called a famous general—I have seen him myself.
idiomatic: The army halted at Baidi; he told men, "Zhuge Kongming may be called a famous general—I have seen him myself.

literal: Beside this city he buried about a hu of crossbow bolts and arrowheads.
idiomatic: Beside this city he buried about a hu of crossbow bolts and arrowheads.

literal: " He planted a marker and ordered it dug up; it was as he said.
idiomatic: " He planted a marker and ordered it dug up; it was as he said.

literal: He also once came beneath a great tree north of Xiangyang city, drew a square two chi on the ground, and had a disciple dig; they found a turtle a chi and a half long. He tapped it with a staff and said: "You wish to come forth but cannot; you have been hundreds of years without meeting me—how would you see the light of day?
idiomatic: He also once came beneath a great tree north of Xiangyang city, drew a square two chi on the ground, and had a disciple dig; they found a turtle a chi and a half long. He tapped it with a staff and said, "You wish to come forth but cannot; you have been hundreds of years without meeting me—how would you see the light of day?

literal: " He gave it the three refuges; the turtle then went into the grass.
idiomatic: " He gave it the three refuges; the turtle then went into the grass.

literal: At first on Badie Mountain there were many afflicted with foul illness; Fahe gathered herbs to treat them—within three doses all were cured, and they at once sought to become disciples.
idiomatic: At first on Badie Mountain there were many afflicted with foul illness; Fahe gathered herbs to treat them—within three doses all were cured, and they at once sought to become disciples.

literal: On the mountain poisonous insects and fierce beasts—Fahe gave them precepts, and they no longer bit or stung.
idiomatic: On the mountain poisonous insects and fierce beasts—Fahe gave them precepts, and they no longer bit or stung.

literal: Wherever he moored on rivers and lakes he always set up a marker on a peak, saying "Life release here.
idiomatic: Wherever he moored on rivers and lakes he always set up a marker on a peak, saying "Life release here.

literal: " Fishermen gained nothing; if they caught even a little, great wind and thunder followed.
idiomatic: " Fishermen gained nothing; if they caught even a little, great wind and thunder followed.

literal: Boatmen in fear released the catch, and wind and rain then stilled.
idiomatic: Boatmen in fear released the catch, and wind and rain then stilled.

literal: Though late in life he led troops, he still forbade all armies fishing and hunting.
idiomatic: Though late in life he led troops, he still forbade all armies fishing and hunting.

literal: Whoever secretly violated—at midnight fierce beasts would come to bite him, or he would lose his mooring line.
idiomatic: Whoever secretly violated—at midnight fierce beasts would come to bite him, or he would lose his mooring line.

literal: A young disciple in play cut off a snake's head and came to Fahe.
idiomatic: A young disciple in play cut off a snake's head and came to Fahe.

literal: Fahe said: "Why did you kill the snake?
idiomatic: Fahe said, "Why did you kill the snake?

literal: " He pointed to show him; the disciple then saw the snake's head biting his trouser flap and not falling away.
idiomatic: " He pointed to show him; the disciple then saw the snake's head biting his trouser flap and not falling away.

literal: Fahe had him repent and perform merit for the snake.
idiomatic: Fahe had him repent and perform merit for the snake.

literal: Again a man tried his blade on an ox; one stroke and the head fell off; he came to Fahe.
idiomatic: Again a man tried his blade on an ox; one stroke and the head fell off; he came to Fahe.

literal: Fahe said: "There is a headless ox coming to you for its life—most urgent; if you do not perform merit for it, retribution will come within a month.
idiomatic: Fahe said, "There is a headless ox coming to you for its life—most urgent; if you do not perform merit for it, retribution will come within a month.

literal: " The man did not believe; within days he indeed died.
idiomatic: " The man did not believe; within days he indeed died.

literal: Fahe also drew house-plans and tomb-sites for men to flee calamity and seek blessing.
idiomatic: Fahe also drew house-plans and tomb-sites for men to flee calamity and seek blessing.

literal: He once told a man: "Do not tie your horse to a pestle.
idiomatic: He once told a man, "Do not tie your horse to a pestle.

literal: " The man passed through a village lane; beside a gate was a pestle, and he tied his horse to its post.
idiomatic: " The man passed through a village lane; beside a gate was a pestle, and he tied his horse to its post.

literal: Entering the gate, he remembered Fahe's warning, ran out to untie it—the horse was already dead.
idiomatic: Entering the gate, he remembered Fahe's warning, ran out to untie it—the horse was already dead.

literal: Emperor Yuan of Liang made Fahe area commander and inspector of Ying province, enfeoffing him as Duke of Jiangcheng county.
idiomatic: Emperor Yuan of Liang made Fahe area commander and inspector of Ying province, enfeoffing him as Duke of Jiangcheng county.

literal: Fahe would not style himself subject; on his memorials a vermilion seal bore only his name, and he called himself Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: Fahe would not style himself subject; on his memorials a vermilion seal bore only his name, and he called himself Minister over the Masses.

literal: Emperor Yuan of Liang said to his vice director Wang Bao: "I never meant to use Lu as one of the Three Dukes—why does he style himself so?
idiomatic: Emperor Yuan of Liang said to his vice director Wang Bao, "I never meant to use Lu as one of the Three Dukes—why does he style himself so?

literal: " Bao said: "He has made himself master of occult arts—perhaps he foreknows.
idiomatic: " Bao said, "He has made himself master of occult arts—perhaps he foreknows.

literal: " Emperor Yuan of Liang, because Fahe's achievements grew weightier, then added the post of Minister over the Masses; area commander and inspector remained as before.
idiomatic: " Emperor Yuan of Liang, because Fahe's achievements grew weightier, then added the post of Minister over the Masses; area commander and inspector remained as before.

literal: His household troops numbered several thousand; he called them all disciples and taught only by occult ways, never imposing penal law on men.
idiomatic: His household troops numbered several thousand; he called them all disciples and taught only by occult ways, never imposing penal law on men.

literal: Within the market rows he established no market magistrate or pastoral assistant law; no one collected dues—only empty cages with locks stood along the roads, a hole opened above to receive coin.
idiomatic: Within the market rows he established no market magistrate or pastoral assistant law; no one collected dues—only empty cages with locks stood along the roads, a hole opened above to receive coin.

literal: Shopkeepers and merchants, according to goods more or less, reckoned the assessed limit and themselves cast into the cage.
idiomatic: Shopkeepers and merchants, according to goods more or less, reckoned the assessed limit and themselves cast into the cage.

literal: The office that kept the books opened and took them only at evening, listed the hole-accounts, and delivered to the treasury.
idiomatic: The office that kept the books opened and took them only at evening, listed the hole-accounts, and delivered to the treasury.

literal: Again, Fahe in ordinary speech, if he did not speak out, when he did discourse was matchlessly eloquent—yet he still bore a barbarian accent.
idiomatic: Again, Fahe in ordinary speech, if he did not speak out, when he did discourse was matchlessly eloquent—yet he still bore a barbarian accent.

literal: He was skilled at making siege engines.
idiomatic: He was skilled at making siege engines.

literal: At Jiangxia he gathered war-ships in great number, intending to strike Xiangyang and enter Wu Pass.
idiomatic: At Jiangxia he gathered war-ships in great number, intending to strike Xiangyang and enter Wu Pass.

literal: Emperor Yuan of Liang sent orders to stop him; Fahe said: "Fahe is a man who seeks the Buddha—he does not even covet the seat of Śakra, Lord of Devas—how would he scheme for kingship?
idiomatic: Emperor Yuan of Liang sent orders to stop him; Fahe said, "Fahe is a man who seeks the Buddha—he does not even covet the seat of Śakra, Lord of Devas—how would he scheme for kingship?

literal: Only at the shrine of the Empty King Buddha do I and my lord share the bond of incense-offering; seeing my lord should have retribution due, I therefore sought aid.
idiomatic: Only at the shrine of the Empty King Buddha do I and my lord share the bond of incense-offering; seeing my lord should have retribution due, I therefore sought aid.

literal: Now that I am already suspected, karma is fixed and cannot be changed.
idiomatic: Now that I am already suspected, karma is fixed and cannot be changed.

literal: " He then set out offering food, with great mallets and thin cakes.
idiomatic: " He then set out offering food, with great mallets and thin cakes.

literal: When Wei raised troops, Fahe himself went from Ying into the Han mouth, about to hurry to Jiangling.
idiomatic: When Wei raised troops, Fahe himself went from Ying into the Han mouth, about to hurry to Jiangling.

literal: Emperor Yuan of Liang sent a man to meet him saying: "We ourselves can break the bandits—only hold Ying province steady; no need to move.
idiomatic: Emperor Yuan of Liang sent a man to meet him saying, "We ourselves can break the bandits—only hold Ying province steady; no need to move.

literal: " Fahe then returned to his province, whitewashed the city gates, wore coarse white cloth shirt and trousers, a slanting headcloth, a great rope about the waist, and sat on a rush mat all day before removing them.
idiomatic: " Fahe then returned to his province, whitewashed the city gates, wore coarse white cloth shirt and trousers, a slanting headcloth, a great rope about the waist, and sat on a rush mat all day before removing them.

literal: When he heard that Emperor Yuan of Liang had been defeated and destroyed, he again donned the former mourning garb, wept, and received condolences.
idiomatic: When he heard that Emperor Yuan of Liang had been defeated and destroyed, he again donned the former mourning garb, wept, and received condolences.

literal: When men of Liang entered Wei, they indeed saw mallets and cakes.
idiomatic: When men of Liang entered Wei, they indeed saw mallets and cakes.

literal: Fahe had first built Shouwang Temple on Bailizhou; after the Buddha hall was raised he cut the pillars and beams shorter, saying: "In some forty years the Buddhist Law will suffer lightning; this temple is secluded and may escape calamity.
idiomatic: Fahe had first built Shouwang Temple on Bailizhou; after the Buddha hall was raised he cut the pillars and beams shorter, saying, "In some forty years the Buddhist Law will suffer lightning; this temple is secluded and may escape calamity.

literal: " When Wei pacified Jing province the palaces were burned to ash; the chief administrator wished to take the Shouwang Buddha hall timber but disliked its short length and stopped.
idiomatic: " When Wei pacified Jing province the palaces were burned to ash; the chief administrator wished to take the Shouwang Buddha hall timber but disliked its short length and stopped.

literal: Later the Zhou house extinguished the Buddhist Law; this temple lay beyond in Chen territory and so did not meet with disaster.
idiomatic: Later the Zhou house extinguished the Buddhist Law; this temple lay beyond in Chen territory and so did not meet with disaster.

literal: In spring of the sixth year of Tianbao, Prince of Qinghe Yue advanced his army to Linjiang; Fahe brought the whole province into Qi.
idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year of Tianbao, Prince of Qinghe Yue advanced his army to Linjiang; Fahe brought the whole province into Qi.

literal: Wenxuan made Fahe grand commander of military affairs over ten provinces, Duke of the Grand Commandant, and Southwestern Route Grand Camp; Song Li, grand commander of five provinces, inspector of Jing, Duke of Anxiang commandery, remained inspector of Ying—office and rank as before.
idiomatic: Wenxuan made Fahe grand commander of military affairs over ten provinces, Duke of the Grand Commandant, and Southwestern Route Grand Camp; Song Li, grand commander of five provinces, inspector of Jing, Duke of Anxiang commandery, remained inspector of Ying—office and rank as before.

literal: Li's younger brother Zao was attendant cavalier, palace gentleman of the third rank, inspector of Xiang, Duke of Yixing county.
idiomatic: Li's younger brother Zao was attendant cavalier, palace gentleman of the third rank, inspector of Xiang, Duke of Yixing county.

literal: The Liang general Hou Tian came pressing on Jiangxia; Qi troops abandoned the city and withdrew; Fahe and the Song Li brothers entered court.
idiomatic: The Liang general Hou Tian came pressing on Jiangxia; Qi troops abandoned the city and withdrew; Fahe and the Song Li brothers entered court.

literal: Wenxuan, hearing of his strange arts, received him with an open heart, fully equipped the insignia of the Three Dukes, and at twelve li south of the city set up a pavilion to await him.
idiomatic: Wenxuan, hearing of his strange arts, received him with an open heart, fully equipped the insignia of the Three Dukes, and at twelve li south of the city set up a pavilion to await him.

literal: Fahe saw Ye city from afar, dismounted, and walked with Yu's pace.
idiomatic: Fahe saw Ye city from afar, dismounted, and walked with Yu's pace.

literal: Xin Shu said to him: "You have come ten thousand li in loyalty; the sovereign receives you with an open heart—why perform this art?
idiomatic: Xin Shu said to him, "You have come ten thousand li in loyalty; the sovereign receives you with an open heart—why perform this art?

literal: " Fahe held an incense burner and walked behind the road chariot to the lodge.
idiomatic: " Fahe held an incense burner and walked behind the road chariot to the lodge.

literal: The next day he was led in audience; he was given a covered carriage with black-lacquered net and a hundred bodyguards.
idiomatic: The next day he was led in audience; he was given a covered carriage with black-lacquered net and a hundred bodyguards.

literal: Coming to the palace he announced his name, styled no office or rank, styled no subject—only called himself the Recluse of Jing Mountain.
idiomatic: Coming to the palace he announced his name, styled no office or rank, styled no subject—only called himself the Recluse of Jing Mountain.

literal: Wenxuan feasted Fahe and his followers in Zhaoyang Hall, granting Fahe a million cash, a thousand lengths of goods, one first-grade mansion, a hundred qing of fields, two hundred slaves, living supplies and utensils in proportion; Song Li a thousand lengths; the rest from palace gentlemen of the third rank down to inspectors each had his difference.
idiomatic: Wenxuan feasted Fahe and his followers in Zhaoyang Hall, granting Fahe a million cash, a thousand lengths of goods, one first-grade mansion, a hundred qing of fields, two hundred slaves, living supplies and utensils in proportion; Song Li a thousand lengths; the rest from palace gentlemen of the third rank down to inspectors each had his difference.

literal: The slaves Fahe received he freed entirely, saying: "Each go as karmic tie leads.
idiomatic: The slaves Fahe received he freed entirely, saying, "Each go as karmic tie leads.

literal: " Cash and silk he gave away in alms and in one day was spent.
idiomatic: " Cash and silk he gave away in alms and in one day was spent.

literal: With the residence the court had granted he built a Buddhist temple and dwelt in one room, no different from ordinary men.
idiomatic: With the residence the court had granted he built a Buddhist temple and dwelt in one room, no different from ordinary men.

literal: Within three years he was again made Grand Commandant; the age still called him the Recluse.
idiomatic: Within three years he was again made Grand Commandant; the age still called him the Recluse.

literal: Without illness he told his disciples the day of his death; when it came, he burned incense, worshipped the Buddha, and died seated on a rope bed.
idiomatic: Without illness he told his disciples the day of his death; when it came, he burned incense, worshipped the Buddha, and died seated on a rope bed.
